request.system:
You are a helpful customer support assistant for Hawa Home, a smart home brand that sells the Hawa Aero ceiling fan, the Hawa Lock S1 smart door lock and the Hawa Pure RO water purifier.

Answer the customer's question. You can use the tools to control their devices.

The customer's devices:
- fan-living: Living room fan (Hawa Aero, room: living room)
- fan-bedroom: Bedroom fan (Hawa Aero, room: bedroom)
- lock-main: Main door lock (Hawa Lock S1, room: main door)
- purifier-kitchen: Kitchen purifier (Hawa Pure RO, room: kitchen)

Some manual sections that may help:
[aero/reset#factory-reset-and-wi-fi-reset] Reset: Factory Reset and Wi-Fi Reset
Wi-Fi reset (keeps your speed settings): press and hold the "Timer" button on the remote for
5 seconds. The LED starts fast blinking blue and the fan is ready to pair again.
Factory reset (erases everything, including Wi-Fi, timers and schedules): press and hold the
"Timer" and "B" (Boost) buttons together for 8 seconds. The fan beeps 4 times and the LED
blinks blue. Alternative without remote: switch the wall switch OFF and ON 5 times, keeping
it ON for about 2 seconds each time; the fan beeps 4 times when the reset is done.
After a factory reset, remove the fan from the Hawa Home app and add it again.

[lock/reset#factory-reset] Reset: Factory Reset
A factory reset deletes all fingerprints, PINs, cards and the admin. It can only be done from
the inside of the door, so only someone already inside can reset the lock. Open the battery
cover on the inner panel, press and hold the small reset button with a pin for 5 seconds until
you hear a long beep, then enter 000# on the keypad. Remove the lock from the app and pair it
again afterwards.

[aero/remote-control#pairing-and-batteries] Remote Control: Pairing and Batteries
The HR-10 remote uses 2 x AAA batteries (do not use the CR2032 coin cell from older Hawa remotes).
If the fan does not respond, replace the batteries first. To pair a new remote: switch the fan
on at the wall and, within 30 seconds, hold the "1" and "5" buttons together for 3 seconds.
The fan beeps once when the remote is paired. One fan can be paired with up to 2 remotes.

[pure/filters#how-to-replace-filters] Filters: How to Replace Filters
Use only genuine Hawa filters. The filter service kit is HP-FK-02 (sediment + carbon) and the
membrane kit is HP-MB-08. Using non-genuine filters voids the warranty.
1. Switch off the purifier and close the inlet water valve.
2. Open the front cover and twist the old filter anticlockwise to remove it.
3. Insert the new filter and twist clockwise until it clicks.
4. Open the inlet valve and switch the purifier on.
5. Reset the filter counter: press and hold the FILTER button for 5 seconds until you hear
   2 beeps (or use the app: Pure RO > Filters > Reset).
6. Drain the first 2 full tanks of water after a filter change; do not drink it.
RO membrane and UV lamp replacement must be done by a Hawa technician.

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Get the live status of one of the user's devices (online, speed, battery, filter life).

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set the speed of a Hawa Aero fan. Speed must be an integer from 1 to 5.

tools.name: check_warranty
tools.description: Check warranty status for a product serial number like HA-AERO-1001.

tools.name: create_service_ticket
tools.description: Raise a service ticket for a technician visit. Needs the device, a short issue description and the user's 10-digit Indian mobile number.

response.text:
To factory reset the Hawa Aero fan using the remote, press and hold the **"Timer"** and **"B" (Boost)** buttons together for **8 seconds**. 

The fan will beep 4 times and the LED will blink blue when the reset is complete. *(Note: This erases everything, including Wi-Fi, timers, and schedules. After a factory reset, you'll need to remove the fan from the Hawa Home app and add it again).*
